verdict.rationale: Mastra documents real-time incremental streaming from agents and workflows, conversion of its streams to AI SDK formats for UI consumption, and PubSub-backed delivery so reconnecting clients don't miss chunks. Evidence that intermediate events reach the stream is limited to the `tool-call-approval` chunk; general tool-call and step events are not explicitly shown. missing for 10: explicit documentation of tool-call and workflow-step event chunks in the stream, independent or hands-on corroboration of UI streaming.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream tokens and intermediate agent events (tool calls, steps) to my UI in real time

citations.quote: Mastra supports real-time, incremental responses from agents and workflows, allowing users to see output as it's generated instead of waiting for completion.
Use `toAISdkStream()` and `toAISdkMessages()` to convert Mastra streams and stored messages to AI SDK-compatible formats.
check for the `tool-call-approval` chunk in the stream to approve or decline the action
Events flow through PubSub, which means a client can disconnect and reconnect without missing chunks.
